design: Exploratory historical disclosure drift; NOT immediate event reaction or causal effect. Date-only disclosure -> next session close entry. Adjusted Yahoo close. Historical public webpages not contemporaneous archives. No expectations surprise data.
exclusions: 2024Q3 NBIS ARR >120M is a lower bound, excluded from exact growth regressions; 2024Q4 retained as baseline.
Anthropic repeat >30B disclosure not counted twice; old $1B/$9B not backdated.
H2 group perimeter changes prevent stitched quarterly series; only explicit comparable QoQ figures admitted.
H3 six growth events provide no credible train/validation/test split; halves diagnostic only.
No automated causal attribution, timing alpha, or transaction-cost-adjusted trading claim.
Anthropic sitemap URL keyword discovery is not exhaustive; sample is retrieved source cohort, not all historic ARR disclosures.

h1_earnings_confound_sensitivity.note: Post-design diagnostic: remove Anthropic dates coincident with known NBIS quarterly release. Other confounders remain.
